current_context.evidence_access: Full artifacts remain in Store. all_fresh_results is the complete STOP citation index; observations is a bounded recent view.

control_initialization_methods.baseline: Pretension, explicit tensions_n, or source+parent with optional channel_map
control_initialization_methods.mathematical_response: response_evidence must be a current verified input_sensitivity analysis; optional channels, trust_radius_n, regularization
control_initialization_methods.physical_response: Optional baseline source+parent; channels, difference_step_n, trust_radius_n, regularization, evaluation_requests; one baseline plus one full rollout per channel, charged to shared budget

control_search_domain.active_coefficients: Optional unique flat indices; inactive coefficients remain zero relative to each start
control_search_domain.response_cost: baseline per start + active coefficient count probes + one proposal per local response iteration; all share one cap
control_search_domain.time_constraint: 0 <= window_start <= knots[0] < knots[-1] <= window_end <= task duration
control_search_domain.multi_start: additional_starts=[{candidate,source,adaptation_from?}]; same task, tendon order and time grid required
